On February 16, 2025, Cambridge Police responded to a Berkeley Place residence for a meet person. A report was taken.

On February 16, 2025 at approximately 12:30pm, I, Officer Harold while assigned to uniformed patrol(10R), in my marked cruiser (223) was dispatched to 6 Berkeley Place for a meet person.

I arrived on location and met with reporting party Cornelius "Adrian" Comstock Vermeule (DOB: 05/02/1968). Adrian stated that he recieved a letter through the mail to his residence that concerned him. The letter which is attached to this report did not contain any threats or threatening language but had racial undertones about Adrian and his wife. Since the letter was anonymous, Adrian decided to contact police. 

Adrian stated he would like a report to start a paper trail in case anymore letters come. Adrian also stated that his main concern was how easy someone was able to find his address. I relayed to Adrian that most information is public record and can be easily obtained from a quick Google search. 

I asked Adrian if anything had occurred in the past weeks, that could have spurred someone to write the letter. Adrian explained he is a writer and just put out an editorial that might have triggered some back lash. 

Adrian apologized but stated it would make him feel more at ease if a report was taken.

Nothing further to add at this time.

On 02/16/2025 Cambridge Police responded to a Central Square buisness for an unwanted party.  A report was taken.

On 02/16/2025 I, Officer Bolt, was assigned to uniform patrol unit Central 10 for the day shift (7 am to 3 pm).  At approximately 12:55 pm Cambridge E.C.C. (Emergency Communication Center) dispatched my unit along with Lieutenant McGrath (C12) to 625 Massachusetts Avenue (Planet Fitness) for an unwanted party.

Units arrived on scene and met with the reporting party Mr. Jarrett Romaine (DOB 08/27/1983).  Mr. Romaine stated that there was a party inside planet fitness talking on his cell phone loudly.  Mr. Romaine went to this individual later identified as Mr. Ibeabuchi Imo (DOB 11/17/1983) and asked if he could lower his voice or go to another area while he spoke on the phone.  Mr. Imo stated that he was not being loud but would move to the tanning section where there would likely be less people.  While Mr. Imo was in the tanning area speaking on the phone another patron of Planet Fitness complained to Mr. Romaine that Mr. Imo was being loud.  Mr. Romaine again spoke to Mr. Imo about speaking on the phone and informed him that if he continued to refuse to lower his voice he would have to call the police.  Mr. Imoi stated that he has the right to be on the phone and to call the police.

Mr. Imo was informed that staff would like him removed from Planet Fitness.  Mr. Imo complied with our request, gathered his belongings and exited the facility....

On 02/16/2025, Cambridge Police responded to Massachusetts Ave after a male fell into a metal grate left open. That male was extricated by the fire departmented and subsequently transported to a local hospital for further medical treatment. 

On 02/16/2025 at 8:53 P.M, I Ofc. Francis, while assigned to 5R, responded with Car 3 (Ofc. Evans and Ofc. Simas), Cambridge Fire Department, and PRO EMS, to the area of 950 Mass. Ave. ECC was informed a male fell down a "deep hole" in the ground. Upon our arrival, officers could clearly see a metal grate ajar from its resting/locked postion on the sidwalk. Approx. 10-15 feet down a male, later identified as James Geldern, was seen lying supine. Geldren was consciouss and alert upon our arrival. 

Cambridge Fire Department was able to extricate Geldern. He was subsequently transported to Cambridge Hospital by PRO for further medical treatment. The Fire Department was able to secure/lock the grate. 

It is unknown at this time why the grate was open prior to Geldern falling in it. A picture of Geldern in the position he was found is attached to this report. ...
